newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy to buy Hunt Oil servicing unit.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy to buy Hunt Oil servicing unit.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Brooks Well Servicing Inc, a Hunt Oil Co subsidiary which owns 32 service rigs and ancillary equipment.
In addition, Key said, it has completed the acquisition of Brownlee Well Service Inc and Integrity Fishing and Rental Tools Inc, which together own 16 service rigs and a fishing tool operation.
Brooks will be acquired for about one million shares of Key Energy common, as a result of which Hunt Oil will become the owner of about 8.8 percent of Key Energy's common.

Brooks provides a full range of well services in East Texas. Brooks will continue to operate under its own name, and will incorporate into that operation the fleet of 13 rigs which Key Energy currently operates in East Texas.
This acquisition, which is scheduled to be completed by December 15, is subject to due diligence, reaching a definitive agreement and approval of Key Energy's board.
